decisions.reason: A classic lever handle costs little to keep in a large catalogue-based range, and one year on the market reveals too little about its value to justify abandoning the option.
A handle family spreads its tooling and catalogue costs across several variants, so keeping it is cheap while market acceptance is still uncertain.
This design variant has low holding costs and no negative evidence yet, so the option is worth keeping open.
Like Product C, this design has only one year of results, which is not enough to show that its value will not be realized, and keeping it costs little.
A lever handle family fits the firm's core business and is inexpensive to maintain while its prospects are still resolving.
The electronic access system with its unique light technology is a strategic growth option with high remaining uncertainty and upside, so the firm keeps it and may invest further.
